subject: fix LTO compilation warning in eval (#3584)
reason: Build-only fix: the eval shebang parser is refactored into an extra local and a serverAssert purely to silence an LTO compilation warning. The pre-existing guard at line 255 (sdslen(parts[0]) < 2 returns C_ERR) already guarantees part0_len >= 2 before the assert, so the assert can never trigger and engine_name_len is computed identically to before. No command reply, replication, persistence, or tool behavior changes, so no scenario can observe a difference between the parent and the change.
